object_description: simple compact rectangular four-story school volume
design_condition: The compact building is precisely set parallel and slightly back from the street, creating a generous western outdoor space while responding to the surrounding height, proportions, trees and slight level differences.

positive.statement: The building naturally fits into the surrounding development in terms of location, height and proportion.

position.rationale: Compact rectangular volume is visible across calibrated views; placement represents its urban scale and proportions.

positive.statement: The compact footprint creates a generous and logically structured outdoor space.

position.rationale: Western edge and low-level open-space condition are approximated from the top and elevation distributions.

positive.statement: The simple typology offers clear orientation, high flexibility and spatial, functional and visual permeability.

position.rationale: Interior organization is not distinguishable; a representative building-surface anchor captures the clear compact typology.

positive.statement: The operational requirements are coherently implemented in the architectural space.

position.rationale: Operational spaces are not individually visible, so the judgment is anchored to a representative building region.

positive.statement: The compactness and clear typology produce very good cost indicators.

position.rationale: Cost performance is a non-spatial judgment without a useful model location.

positive.statement: The energy goals are implemented in a self-evident way through compactness, insulation, solar gains and building technology.

position.rationale: Compact envelope and roof-level solar relationship provide a broad building anchor for the energy judgment.

negative.statement: The lighting of the design space in the basement remains in need of improvement.

position.rationale: Basement condition is constrained to the lowest sampled level, though no distinct interior basement room is visible.

negative.statement: The facade has a rather restless and somewhat random-looking expression.

position.rationale: No specific facade is named; a representative exterior elevation anchor captures the expressed envelope.

negative.statement: The access side to the street is unsatisfactory and needs to be fundamentally revised.

position.rationale: Street-facing access is approximated along the front lower facade, with no distinct entrance visible in the sample.
